October volume growth exceeded 12% YoY, while management expects 12–13% volume growth in H2FY27.

Its strong regional franchise, improving demand, and opportunity to gain market share from outside suppliers should support volume growth. • Significant Capacity Expansion to Drive Long-Term Growth: The company is undertaking an ambitious capacity expansion programme, including 6mt of additional capacity in Northern India and a proposed 2mt grinding unit in Eastern India.
